items.title: Saudi FDI inflows surge 33.5% to SR159.1 billion in 2025
items.source_excerpt: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows increased by 33.5 percent to SR159.1 billion in 2025, compared with SR119.2 billion in 2024, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). The increase came as the Kingdom’s total FDI stock rose by 8.3 percent to SR1.06 trillion by the end of 2025, while net FDI inflows increased by 1.7 percent to SR81.4 billion, compared with SR80 billion in 2024.
